title: Domio CRDT Slide Sub-Document
description: Documents the Yjs sub-document shape for a single slide within a deck. Each slide lives in its own Y.Doc so concurrent edits to different slides don't create merge conflicts. The shape mirrors the structure in packages/yjs-shared/src/subdocs.ts.

semanticId.description: Stable semantic key for the slide (e.g. 'intro', 'chart-revenue').

position.description: Zero-based position in the deck's slide order.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the slide.

notes.description: Optional speaker notes for the slide.

ratioW.description: Width component of the aspect ratio.

ratioH.description: Height component of the aspect ratio.

zOrder.description: Y.Array('zOrder') — element IDs in render order (RGA). Determines the visual stacking/z-order of layers.

elements.description: Y.Array('elements') — all element IDs present in this slide (append-only RGA).

elementProps.description: Y.Map('elementProps') — keyed by element ID, each value is a Y.Map of element properties.

text.description: Y.Text instances stored as 'text:{elementId}' — live collaborative text content for text-type elements.

ElementProps.description: Y.Map per-element property bag. Stores the element's static properties that are not collaborative text.

semanticId.description: Stable semantic key for the element.

parentId.description: Parent element ID or null for root-level elements.

z.description: Numeric z-order value (derived from zOrder array position).

locked.description: Whether the element is locked from editing.

hidden.description: Whether the element is hidden from view.
